headline: Reckonings, Retrospectives, *Resistance*
intro: This week's Algorithm surveys colonial reckonings on screen and in stone, surveillance tech turned against itself, and sound worlds from Lagos to the Hardanger fjords. Elsewhere: architecture that argues for arcs of resistance, and literature grappling with reason, ruin, and return.

entries.title: Nigeria 80: The Explosive Sound World of 1980s Nigeria
entries.author: Justin Gage
entries.summary: The ’70s didn’t end. They just got more elastic. Strut’s Nigeria 80 catches Nigerian popular music in that beautiful, unruly stretch between Afrobeat’s explosion and whatever came next—juju, funk, highlife, reggae, proto-hip-hop, and plenty of glorious cross-pollination along the way. The post Nigeria 80: The Explosive Sound World of 1980s Nigeria first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard.
